//: RESEARCH-ONLY config -- SECONDARY/VALIDATION data source, not the default. Never used for live trading, never referenced by the live bot process (see user_data/config.json for that). Use this to cross-check backtest results against a second venue after running the same backtest against user_data/config-research.json (Hyperliquid, primary). As of introduction, Binance USD-M futures returns HTTP 451 'Service unavailable from a restricted location' when reached from Railway's current region (us-west2/sfo) -- a Binance-side geo-restriction, not a bug in this repo. Left in place for whenever that's no longer a blocker (a different Railway region, a different network path, etc.), not deleted.

exchange.//: binanceusdm as a secondary DATA SOURCE only -- research backtests never place orders (dry_run is always true above, and hermes backtest never runs `freqtrade trade`). Same pairs as the primary (Hyperliquid) research config, since StatArbSwing.Y_PAIR/X_PAIR are hardcoded to these two. No API key/secret needed: public OHLCV endpoints don't require authentication (when reachable).
exchange.name: binanceusdm
